en: Colorized vintage street scene showing a canal or washing trough along a narrow lane in a European town. Women wash clothes at the water's edge while others stand or walk nearby. Tall stucco buildings with green shutters line the street; laundry hangs from a long wooden balcony. A handwritten message appears along the right margin, and a printed caption at the bottom reads "TRENTO." There is a red postage stamp with cancellation marks in the upper left corner.
